flavorText: The statue of a coiled, black snake, small enough to fit in the palm of your hand. It represents the force known as Sithis.
name: Sithis Shrine Statue

title: Shards of Nothing
flavorText: Large pieces of black onyx, carried by priests of Sithis for various meditation practices.
name: Shards of Nothing

title: Sacrificial Sithis Dagger
flavorText: A large black dagger, ancient and dull, reputedly used to perform sacrifices to the great force of Sithis.
name: Sacrificial Sithis Dagger

title: Nine-Shells Game Pieces
flavorText: These shells, carved with beautiful detail, are used to play the game nine-shells.
name: Nine-Shells Game Pieces

title: Shells and Stones Board
flavorText: A small, flat reed mat with several strange markings upon it. Used in the game shells and stones.
name: Shells and Stones Board

title: Teeba-Enoo Ball
flavorText: Similar to a teeba-hatsei ball, Argonians claim it to be drastically different, though they're unwilling to state how.
name: Teeba-Enoo Ball

title: Venom Heart Cardset
flavorText: This unusual pack of cards is used to play the cooperative game venom heart.
name: Venom Heart Cardset

title: Rules of Teeba-Enoo
flavorText: This attempt by a Breton to write the rules of Teeba-Enoo quickly descends into incoherent madness.
name: Rules of Teeba-Enoo

title: Scale Scrubber
flavorText: A thick brush used to rub off shedding scales. Not recommended for non-Argonian use.
name: Scale Scrubber

title: Horn Sharpener
flavorText: This thin, elongated whetstone is just perfect for getting your horns handsomely sharp.
name: Horn Sharpener

title: Bug Shell Fang Cleaner
flavorText: This mixture of ground ultra-hard bug shells is the perfect way of cleaning out any unwanted debris trapped in your fangs!
name: Bug Shell Fang Cleaner

title: Clay Face Lotion
flavorText: A jar of unknown clay substance, said to soften even the thickest and roughest scales.
name: Clay Face Lotion

title: Spine Polish
flavorText: For the Argonian who wants to look their best whenever they erect the spine of greeting!
name: Spine Polish

title: Herbal Moisturizer
flavorText: Though this collection of herbs does wonders for Argonian skin, it is known to be an irritant to every other race.
name: Herbal Moisturizer

title: Reed Paper Roll
flavorText: A thick sheet of reed paper covered in illegible scribbles and symbols.
name: Reed Paper Roll

title: Snakeskin Book Cover
flavorText: An empty book cover made of iridescent snakeskin.
name: Snakeskin Book Cover

title: Dead-Water Bone Quill
flavorText: Even the scholars of the Dead-Water tribe honor their fallen egg-siblings by creating writing supplies from their bones.
name: Dead-Water Bone Quill

title: Xul-Vaat Graver
flavorText: This ceremonial engraving tool is used to carve symbols and images into grave-stakes.
name: Xul-Vaat Graver

title: Venomous Inkwell
flavorText: Though this ink dries into a lovely deep purple color, it's also known to be mildly toxic.
name: Venomous Inkwell

title: Bright-Throat Stamp
flavorText: A stamp used for sealing correspondence between the Bright-Throats and their non-Argonian allies.
name: Bright-Throat Stamp

title: Toad Ladle
flavorText: This ladle's name stems from both the size of its bowl and its traditional usage in serving toad stew.
name: Toad Ladle

title: Bug Meat-Pick
flavorText: A long, thin rod with a curved end. Used to separate bug meat from its shell.
name: Bug Meat-Pick

title: Rusted Imperial Fork
flavorText: The original Imperial owner has long abandoned this antique two-tined fork.
name: Rusted Imperial Fork

title: Tarnished Serving Tray
flavorText: This once highly polished silver tray is now teal from the variety of molds that grow upon it.
name: Tarnished Serving Tray

title: Hairy Scales
flavorText: The fine coating of hair sprouting from these scales simply begs the question; what manner of creature did they once belong to?
name: Hairy Scales

title: Mossy Deer Skull
flavorText: The presence of a deer skull in a swamp raises many questions. Its gruesome ceremonial carvings raises several more.
name: Mossy Deer Skull

title: Elongated Saxhleel Claws
flavorText: Though these claws appear to be Argonian in appearance, their size and length are baffling.
name: Elongated Saxhleel Claws

title: Emerald-Eyed Stag Pendant
flavorText: Small, emerald eyes stare up from this stag head pendant, daring you to give yourself over to the Hunt.
name: Emerald-Eyed Stag Pendant

title: Mysterious Saliva Sample
flavorText: The saliva within this vial seems to exhibit both canine and reptile qualities. What could produce such slobber?
name: Mysterious Saliva Sample

title: Heavily Decayed Gears
flavorText: A heavy coating of moss and decay make it nearly impossible to discern the original shape and use of these gears.
name: Heavily Decayed Gears

title: Mud-Choked Mechanism
flavorText: Decades buried under swamp mud have now rendered this mechanism useless.
name: Mud-Choked Mechanism

title: Rusted Sprocket Wheel
flavorText: The heavy humidity of the swamp has rusted this sprocket wheel beyond repair.
name: Rusted Sprocket Wheel

title: Decoy Croak Crank
flavorText: A small reed box with a crank attached to its side. The frog croak it produces can aid in capturing the creatures.
name: Decoy Croak Crank

title: Rotating Xul-Vaat
flavorText: Place this grave-stake in the mud, wind it up, and see it spin! Created by a short-lived Imperial entrepreneur.
name: Rotating Xul-Vaat

title: Daril Spines
flavorText: These tiny quills are coated in daril, ready to be inserted into the skin around the eyes for an intense sensory experience.
name: Daril Spines

title: Skin Scraper
flavorText: A cartilaginous tool used to scrape secretions from poisonous fauna without damaging their skin.
name: Skin Scraper

title: Swamp Reed Skooma Pipe
flavorText: Made from ornately engraved, stiff plant stalks, this pipe's ceremonial designs disguise its intended purpose.
name: Swamp Reed Skooma Pipe

title: Beginners' Frog Net
flavorText: Comprised of a downy woven-moss net and a lightweight wooden frame, this net doubles as a floating snare for unwary frogs.
name: Beginners' Frog Net

title: Hist Whistle
flavorText: A simple flute whistle carved from a fallen Hist branch. Not used to call to the Hist, despite persistent misconceptions.
name: Hist Whistle

title: Seed Doll Sprout
flavorText: This budding seed bristles with new growth, ready for a young Bright-Throat to practice the art of trimming it.
name: Seed Doll Sprout

title: Spongy Teeba-Hatsei Ball
flavorText: A softer than competitive snake leather ball with a swamp jelly core, making it ideal for performing tricks.
name: Spongy Teeba-Hatsei Ball

title: Amber Plasm Pacifier
flavorText: Hardened Hist sap in the shape of a flat paddle for teething Argonians to chew. Enjoyed by hatchlings and adults alike.
name: Amber Plasm Pacifier

title: Clay Xeech-Bok
flavorText: A painted, white clay bowl popular among Bright-Throats for serving nuts to visitors.
name: Clay Xeech-Bok

title: Mite Sieve
flavorText: This bowl of cypress wood is erratically riddled with tiny holes just large enough for liquid to drain out, but not much else.
name: Mite Sieve

title: Swamp Grass Ajum
flavorText: Primarily used to serve live butterflies, moths, and other flying insects, this delicate woven tray has a finely netted lid.
name: Swamp Grass Ajum

title: Copper Meht Pan
flavorText: A long, shallow pan used for baking, but it makes an acceptable substitute for a griddle when the mood for mud cakes arises.
name: Copper Meht Pan

title: Aojee-Sakka Purge Vase
flavorText: Wide mouthed with a narrow neck, this funnel-like table decoration is kept at hand in case the deadly toad is poorly prepared.
name: Aojee-Sakka Purge Vase

title: Cocoon Decanter
flavorText: Created by the careful molding of a giant sorrow moth's cocoon into a translucent pitcher.
name: Cocoon Decanter

title: Cordon Net
flavorText: A large vine-net intended to be used by more than one person to envelop and entangle fugitives.
name: Cordon Net

title: Vial of Scarring Slime
flavorText: Some tribes mark convicts on the forehead with voriplasm, leaving a temporary, but long-lasting brand to identify criminals.
name: Vial of Scarring Slime

title: Deep Scaling Brush
flavorText: A bristled brush of flexible thorns to get grime out from under the scales of beasts of burden and Saxhleel alike.
name: Deep Scaling Brush

title: Glooba Jikei
flavorText: This oddly shaped pole is used to stir deep mud up to the surface. Great for mudskipper fishing and lost keys.
name: Glooba Jikei

title: Scrimshaw Bone-Worker
flavorText: Knife, pick, and chisel-this simple bronze tool is a versatile implement for carving bone, horn, and chitin.
name: Scrimshaw Bone-Worker

title: Skinning Stone
flavorText: A razor-sharp piece of volcanic glass meant to be pinched between the fore and middle fingers like a claw. Compact and precise.
name: Skinning Stone

title: Reed Scythe
flavorText: This sharpened leviathan scale blade can reap sugarcane and dense swamp growth in great swaths with little effort.
name: Reed Scythe

title: Hackwing Training Kit
flavorText: A reinforced bone gauntlet and visor, leather hood, wooden whistle, and padded bludgeon for hackwing obedience training.
name: Hackwing Training Kit

title: Grasswear Rejuvenant
flavorText: A simple alchemical lotion to preserve grass woven garments from dry rot, wet rot, and rot in general.
name: Grasswear Rejuvenant

title: Mud Sack Pillow
flavorText: This pillow is soft, shape-conforming, and water permeable to ensure a moist night's sleep.
name: Mud Sack Pillow

title: Frill Clips
flavorText: A lukiul fashion trend taking root in Murkmire. These silver slivers provide just enough pinch to hold Argonian frills in place.
name: Frill Clips

title: Leviathan Bile Bone Bleach
flavorText: This acrid smelling white paste excels at leaching pigment and stains from deep within bone jewelry, but may damage scrimshaw.
name: Leviathan Bile Bone Bleach

title: Ample Serpent Garment Wrap
flavorText: Durable and waterproof, this sleek hide is used to protect delicate textiles from damage.
name: Ample Serpent Garment Wrap

title: Kotu Gava Blood Cocktail
flavorText: This libation is made from mingled blood extracted from predatory marsh bugs. Coagulated, but still useful for ritual purposes.
name: Kotu Gava Blood Cocktail

title: Vakka-Shuxalt Amulet
flavorText: Devotees of Xulneihavu Shuxaltsei wear this icon of a polished, yellow amber orb set in the mouth of a serpent's skull.
name: Vakka-Shuxalt Amulet

title: Tattered Blackguard Gang Patch
flavorText: The last remnants of an outcast's old existence among the living.
name: Tattered Blackguard Gang Patch

title: Veeskhleel Binding Skein
flavorText: A ritual fetish of stretched Argonian sinew looping around itself in an arcane pattern. Believed to charm the vengeful dead.
name: Veeskhleel Binding Skein

title: Destroyer's Gore Chalice
flavorText: A stone vessel used for blood sacrifices to Sithis in ancient times, but there are signs of recent use.
name: Destroyer's Gore Chalice

title: Raw Leviathan Pearl
flavorText: About the size of a Saxhleel head, this marble-like stone develops whorls of color as it forms while passing through the beast.
name: Raw Leviathan Pearl

title: Palm Oil Spine Balm
flavorText: What better way to keep an Argonian's expressive spines healthy and moist than with a soothing balm made of palm oil?
name: Palm Oil Spine Balm

title: Gee-Lo's Ridge Liner
flavorText: Argonians use this gel to enhance and elongate the apparent size or depth of their facial and head ridges.
name: Gee-Lo's Ridge Liner

title: Gee-Lo's Claw Polish
flavorText: Used to add a splash of color to finger and toe claws, the vibrant polish has garnered the interest of non-Argonians.
name: Gee-Lo's Claw Polish

title: Kwama Wax Scale Cream
flavorText: Imported from Morrowind, this waxy cream helps keep Argonian scales shiny and moist.
name: Kwama Wax Scale Cream

title: Healer Jaxit's Gold Horn Polish
flavorText: When an Argonian wants to make a good impression, nothing beats an application of this expensive polish for horns of all sizes.
name: Healer Jaxit's Gold Horn Polish

title: Healer Jaxit's Dryskin Lashes
flavorText: False eyelashes for Argonians who want to emulate that hairy, dryskin look. Rare, as the product never caught on.
name: Healer Jaxit's Dryskin Lashes

title: Miregaunt Ward Charm
flavorText: A charm carved from a discarded miregaunt branch believed to ward off the attention of the marsh guardians.
name: Miregaunt Ward Charm

title: Pressed Hist Leaf
flavorText: A leaf from an Argonian's Hist tree, pressed flat and preserved as a reminder of tribe and family.
name: Pressed Hist Leaf

title: Sacred Seeds of Black Marsh
flavorText: A pouch containing imitation seeds of a Hist tree, sold to gullible non-Argonians for their reputed fertile properties.
name: Sacred Seeds of Black Marsh

title: Murkmire Story Catcher
flavorText: A woven net hung above a dwelling to gather stories that meander through the marsh before an elder presents them to the tribe.
name: Murkmire Story Catcher

title: Imperial Eye of Akatosh
flavorText: This holy symbol was popular among the Imperial Legionnaires who once encroached upon Black Marsh.
name: Imperial Eye of Akatosh

title: Kagouti Drinking Horn
flavorText: Carved with tribal symbols, this common drinking vessel is utilized by many of the tribes of Black Marsh.
name: Kagouti Drinking Horn

title: Haj Mota Hatchling Bowl
flavorText: A bowl made from the shell of a haj mota hatchling, decorated with Argonian tribal motifs.
name: Haj Mota Hatchling Bowl

title: Dead-Water Gourd of Vigor
flavorText: A drinking vessel used by the Dead-Water tribe, reputed to increase the strength of whoever drinks from it.
name: Dead-Water Gourd of Vigor

title: Battlehorn Wine, Rare Vintage
flavorText: An empty bottle of Imperial wine. The label indicates that the vintage is rare and potentially of interest to collectors.
name: Battlehorn Wine, Rare Vintage

title: Imperial Legion Stein
flavorText: An ornate drinking tankard, decorated with allusions to Cyrodiil's Imperial Legions.
name: Imperial Legion Stein

title: Ceremonial Drinking Horn
flavorText: Carved from the horn of a great kagouti and inscribed with ceremonial runes, this type of cup is used in important rituals.
name: Ceremonial Drinking Horn

title: Bright-Throat Hook Wrap
flavorText: A scarf used to hang hooks for easy access while fishing, made popular by the anglers of the Bright-Throat tribe.
name: Bright-Throat Hook Wrap

title: Dead-Water Fishing Net
flavorText: A net used by the Dead-Water tribe to gather fish, it is weighted with the bones of past master anglers of the tribe.
name: Dead-Water Fishing Net

title: Dead-Water Tackle Basket
flavorText: The Dead-Water tribe weaves baskets lined with wamasu hide to use to carry their fishing equipment.
name: Dead-Water Tackle Basket

title: Bright-Throat Worm Caddy
flavorText: A waterproof container crafted by the Bright-Throat tribe, perfect for carrying a variety of fishing bait.
name: Bright-Throat Worm Caddy

title: Imperial Legion Hook Strap
flavorText: An ancient Imperial leather strap that was standard Legionnaire issue, it still contains a few rusted fish hooks.
name: Imperial Legion Hook Strap

title: Vossa-Satl Tuning Key
flavorText: A wooden key used to tune a vossa-satl musical instrument by altering the size of the frog containment chambers.
name: Vossa-Satl Tuning Key

title: Murkmire Finger Drums
flavorText: Wood and leather caps worn on the fingers, when tapped together they produce a pleasing sound.
name: Murkmire Finger Drums

title: Bright-Throat Ridge Chimes
flavorText: Small pieces of bone, stone, or metal, hung from an Argonian's head ridges so that they jangle and clink when they walk.
name: Bright-Throat Ridge Chimes

title: Legionnaire Marching Song
flavorText: An ancient Imperial scroll containing the words and musical notes for a popular marching song.
name: Legionnaire Marching Song

title: Dead-Water Throat Songs
flavorText: A collection of sheet music detailing the throat songs of the Naga-Kur--battle hymns, marching songs, and challenge chants.
name: Dead-Water Throat Songs

title: Dead-Water Battle Gong
flavorText: A metal plate secured to the arm by a leather strap; Dead-Water warriors strike them with their weapons to frighten enemies.
name: Dead-Water Battle Gong

title: Argonian Shell Vise
flavorText: A vise composed of hard shells and metal, used by Argonian blacksmiths throughout Black Marsh.
name: Argonian Shell Vise

title: Argonian Hot Punch
flavorText: A tool for shaping and working with hot metal, used by Argonian blacksmiths throughout Black Marsh.
name: Argonian Hot Punch

title: Murkmire Ceremonial Chisels
flavorText: A set of blacksmith chisels with handles carved to represent animals native to the Murkmire region of Black Marsh.
name: Murkmire Ceremonial Chisels

title: Imperial Smithing Pliers
flavorText: A set of pliers stamped with the symbol of the Imperial Legion and used by smiths to keep armor and weapons in good repair.
name: Imperial Smithing Pliers

title: Imperial Smithing Tongs
flavorText: A set of tongs stamped with the symbol of the Imperial Legion and used by smiths to keep armor and weapons in good repair.
name: Imperial Smithing Tongs

title: Argonian Shell Verse
flavorText: A fragment of Argonian egg shell, the interior inscribed with a verse that has sentimental meaning to its author.
name: Argonian Shell Verse

title: Pact Recruitment Pamphlet
flavorText: This pamphlet urges Argonians to take up arms and volunteer to fight for the Ebonheart Pact in the Three Banners War.
name: Pact Recruitment Pamphlet

title: Cyrodilic Boudoir Etching
flavorText: A partially torn but otherwise well-preserved etching of a bawdy scene, most likely brought to Murkmire by a lonely Legionnaire.
name: Cyrodilic Boudoir Etching

title: Imperial Opera House Poster
flavorText: The burned and torn remains of a poster commemorating a performance by Pursius Solo, probably carried by a Legionnaire.
name: Imperial Opera House Poster

title: Imperial Ninth Legion Badge
flavorText: A badge worn by members of the Imperial Ninth Legion that marched through Murkmire and disappeared.
name: Imperial Ninth Legion Badge

title: Nesting Thtithils
flavorText: This child's toy is a series of multicolored wooden eggs nested one inside of the other.
name: Nesting Thtithils

title: Squeaky Tsonashap
flavorText: This frog-shaped squeaky toy made of soft rubber will keep a hatchling amused for hours.
name: Squeaky Tsonashap

title: Gilly the River Troll
flavorText: This one-eyed stuffed troll is purple with Green spots, and much cuter than its fearsome real-life counterpart.
name: Gilly the River Troll

title: Spring-Loaded Thuxis
flavorText: When opened, this innocent-looking wooden container launches a spring-loaded snake.
name: Spring-Loaded Thuxis

title: Nora the Newborn Nord
flavorText: This finely-crafted child's baby doll wearing a furry wolf's-hide diaper is obviously imported.
name: Nora the Newborn Nord

title: Wind-Up Dragon Frog
flavorText: When its key is wound, this child's tin toy hops about shooting sparks from its mouth.
name: Wind-Up Dragon Frog

title: Marsh Pillow
flavorText: An absorbent camping pillow used to sit squishily upon in the outdoors.
name: Marsh Pillow

title: Woven Place Mats
flavorText: Dining place mats made from woven strands of dried marsh grass.
name: Woven Place Mats

title: Bright-Throat Bedroll
flavorText: An oilskin bedroll embroidered with symbols of the Bright-Throat tribe.
name: Bright-Throat Bedroll

title: Silk Bed Dressing
flavorText: A set of fine-quality bed sheets spun from the silk of giant spiders.
name: Silk Bed Dressing

title: Bear Lizard Saddle Blanket
flavorText: A fine quality saddle blanket commonly used with Bear Lizard mounts.
name: Bear Lizard Saddle Blanket

title: Woven Privacy Screen
flavorText: A folding, three-paneled  privacy screen crafted of woven marsh grass.
name: Woven Privacy Screen

title: Xanmeer Blessing Charm
flavorText: This talisman of feather and bone is hung over the entrance to a xanmeer to bring good fortune.
name: Xanmeer Blessing Charm

title: Rain-Bringer Talisman
flavorText: A charm sold in back alleys that supposedly brings delightfully wet weather and gray skies to its bearer.
name: Rain-Bringer Talisman

title: Argonian Alchemy Flask
flavorText: A graduated glass flask used for mixing alchemic ingredients.
name: Argonian Alchemy Flask

title: Neesak of Scrying
flavorText: A multi-faceted Green swamp crystal purportedly used for fortune-telling.
name: Neesak of Scrying

title: Bottomless Mug of Bile Beer
flavorText: This mildly enchanted bile beer mug refills itself each time it is emptied.
name: Bottomless Mug of Bile Beer

title: Su-Zahleel Dowsing Rod
flavorText: A Y-shaped divining rod used to locate  ground water, buried metals, gemstones, oil, or gravesites.
name: Su-Zahleel Dowsing Rod

title: Ojel Gel
flavorText: An imported disinfectant and anti-inflammatory medical gel.
name: Ojel Gel

title: Sharth's Mortar and Pestle
flavorText: Apothecary implements used to prepare ingredients by crushing or grinding them into paste or powder.
name: Sharth's Mortar and Pestle

title: Shellback Warrior Medical Kit
flavorText: A soldier's first aid kit containing various bandages, curatives, and scale liniment in a handy shoulder bag.
name: Shellback Warrior Medical Kit

title: Chewbark Headache Remedy
flavorText: A pouch of dried tree bark known for its ability to cure headaches and minor aches and pains.
name: Chewbark Headache Remedy

title: Jar of Pickled Frog Eyes
flavorText: Though considered delicacies by some tribes, these are more commonly used to settle a sour stomach.
name: Jar of Pickled Frog Eyes

title: Vial of Bamphor Squeezings
flavorText: An essential oil with a very high alcohol content, used for disinfecting wounds and calming a patient.
name: Vial of Bamphor Squeezings

title: Kaal's Badge of Honor
flavorText: A badge of made from the carved shell of a young haj mota presented to warriors for distinguished service.
name: Kaal's Badge of Honor

title: Chukka Sei Necklace
flavorText: A ceremonial crocodile tooth necklace, worn by Argonian youth during their maturation trial.
name: Chukka Sei Necklace

title: Divination Bones
flavorText: An eelskin pouch containing small animal bones painted with bright colors, used for fortune-telling.
name: Divination Bones

title: Tail of Never-Gives-Up
flavorText: The engraved plaque on this mounted, mummified tail identifies it as that of an Argonian war hero.
name: Tail of Never-Gives-Up

title: Shrunken Monkey Head
flavorText: This shriveled, mummified head of a monkey is intended to be a charm to ward off evil swamp spirits.
name: Shrunken Monkey Head

title: Dragon Badger
flavorText: This oddity was constructed by combining the preserved and mounted body parts of a badger and a dragon viper.
name: Dragon Badger

title: Shadowscale Medallion
flavorText: A brass medallion inscribed with the likeness of Sithis, the Dread Father, used to identify fellow members of the Shadowscales.
name: Shadowscale Medallion

title: Bronze Crocodile
flavorText: A pocket charm fashioned in the form of a crocodile, intended to bestow good hunting upon the holder.
name: Bronze Crocodile

title: Torchbug Amberlight
flavorText: This amber-encased torchbug is charmed so that its thorax will glow eternally, providing a handy pocket light for its bearer.
name: Torchbug Amberlight

title: Hackwing Weather Vane
flavorText: The carved wooden weather vane, shaped like a hackwing, is used to determine changes in wind direction.
name: Hackwing Weather Vane

title: Dragonfly Brooch
flavorText: A lovely jeweled brooch in the shape of a marsh dragonfly.
name: Dragonfly Brooch

title: Fossilized Centipede
flavorText: A piece of shale impressed with the remains of an ancient Black Marsh centipede.
name: Fossilized Centipede

title: Wamasu Handler's Prod
flavorText: A telescoping wamasu prod, insulated by hist sap rubber to guard against the beast's electrical discharge.
name: Wamasu Handler's Prod

title: Panther Skin Sun Parasol
flavorText: An Argonian lady's parasol, used to prevent the hot sun from drying out her scales.
name: Panther Skin Sun Parasol

title: Snakeskin Belt Pouch
flavorText: A snakeskin pouch with a secret compartment where coins can be concealed to prevent their theft.
name: Snakeskin Belt Pouch

title: Pouch of Dried Marshweed
flavorText: A pouch of dried smoke weed popular among Bright-Throat elders.
name: Pouch of Dried Marshweed

title: Argonian Tooth Sharpener
flavorText: A cylindrical sharpening stone with a hollow center, used to sharpen teeth for defensive and cosmetic purposes.
name: Argonian Tooth Sharpener

title: Empress Tavia's Tapestry Needle
flavorText: A large needle, gilded in gold. It is said to have been owned by Empress Tavia herself.
name: Empress Tavia's Tapestry Needle

title: Red Bramman's Hourglass
flavorText: This large navigator's tool, said to have been owned by Red Bramman himself, is made of a heavy petrified wood.
name: Red Bramman's Hourglass

title: Ninth Legion Commander's Seal
flavorText: The purported signet of the commander of the legendary Imperial Ninth Legion, lost in Murkmire a generation ago.
name: Ninth Legion Commander's Seal

title: Sisei Leather Pouch
flavorText: A small leather pouch, covered in images of small sprouts. Given to young hatchlings to remind them to "ever grow."
name: Sisei Leather Pouch

title: Tester's Infinite Envelope of Event Tickets
flavorText: Found through PTS character templates. Can be opened for a bevy of Event Tickets, and also contains another Envelope just like itself.
name: Tester's Infinite Envelope of Event Tickets

title: Blackrose Weapons, Perfected
flavorText: This container holds a collection of Perfected weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose Weapons, Perfected

title: Blackrose: Perfected Two Handed
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Perfected Two Handed

title: Blackrose: Perfected One Handed and Shield
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Perfected One Handed and Shield

title: Blackrose: Perfected Dual Wield
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Perfected Dual Wield

title: Blackrose: Perfected Bow
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Perfected Bow

title: Blackrose: Perfected Destruction Staff
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Perfected Destruction Staff

title: Lies of the Dread-Father
flavorText: The words of Nisswo Xeewulm, preserved exactly as written.
name: Lies of the Dread-Father

title: Blackrose: Perfected Restoration Staff
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Perfected Restoration Staff

title: Blackrose Weapons
flavorText: This container holds a collection of weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose Weapons

title: That of Void
flavorText: The words of Nisswo Xeewulm, preserved exactly as written.
name: That of Void

title: Acts of Honoring
flavorText: The words of Nisswo Xeewulm, preserved exactly as written.
name: Acts of Honoring

title: Speakers of Nothing
flavorText: The words of Nisswo Xeewulm, preserved exactly as written.
name: Speakers of Nothing

title: Blackrose: One Handed and Shield
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: One Handed and Shield

title: Blackrose: Dual Wield
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Dual Wield

title: Blackrose: Two Handed
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Two Handed

title: Blackrose: Bow
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Bow

title: Blackrose: Destruction Staff
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Destruction Staff

title: Blackrose: Restoration Staff
flavorText: Ability-Altering Weapons found in Blackrose Prison.
name: Blackrose: Restoration Staff

title: Bust: Abnur Tharn
flavorText: Experience the wisdom of Abnur Tharn within your very own home with this talking bust! Display this noble piece of statuary in a place of prominence so that you and every houseguest may listen intently to the former Grand Chancellor.
name: Bust: Abnur Tharn

title: Cadwell's Astounding Portal
flavorText: Ready for a jolly good time with Cadwell? Summon him to your home with this handy portal, and he'll play a tune, juggle fish, indulge in some chit-chat, or more! |cFFFFFFAlas, Cadwell refuses to do preview performances.|r
name: Cadwell's Astounding Portal

title: Style Page: Lord Warden Mask
flavorText: Use to learn the Lord Warden Mask Outfit Style. This page can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores. This page is consumed when read, granting you the account-wide Collectible.
name: Style Page: Lord Warden Mask

title: Target Iron Atronach, Trial
flavorText: This is a large house item. This may be attacked and, when destroyed, will reassemble. This construct is equivalent to a veteran trial boss. Its abilities include granting a resource-restoring synergy opportunity, performance buffs, and self debuffs.
name: Target Iron Atronach, Trial

title: Riddles of the Rithana-di-Renada
flavorText: Supposedly penned by a Shadow of Rajhin, these cryptic clues point the way to the missing pieces of the Rithana-di-Renada.
name: Riddles of the Rithana-di-Renada

title: Mummified Alfiq Parts
abilityDescription:
With these, you can eventually assemble your own Grisly Mummy Tabby. One will be yours after using 10. If you already have this collectible, these serve only to earn the achievement.

Progress: |cffffff10|r/10
flavorText: Part of a mummified alfiq. With enough of these, you could build your own.
name: Mummified Alfiq Parts

title: Plague-Drenched Fabric
abilityDescription:
With these, you can eventually assemble your own Peryite Skeevemaster Robe. One will be yours after using 10. If you already have this collectible, these serve only to earn the achievement.

Progress: |cffffff10|r/10
flavorText: Part of a Peryite cultist's robe. With enough of these, you could tailor your own.
name: Plague-Drenched Fabric
